# Acme Remote Work Handbook

## Eligibility

Employees who have completed their 90-day probation period are eligible for remote work. Contractors and interns are not eligible for remote work under this policy.

## Equipment

The company provides every remote employee with a laptop and a monthly internet stipend. External monitors can be requested from the IT service desk and are delivered within ten business days.

| Item | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Internet stipend | 50 EUR per month |
| Home office budget | 400 EUR one-time |

## Security

All remote work must use the corporate VPN when accessing internal systems. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the security team within 24 hours. Public Wi-Fi may only be used together with the VPN.

## Working hours

Remote employees keep core collaboration hours from 10:00 to 15:00 Central European Time. Meetings outside core hours require the agreement of all participants.
